metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2026 · Mourinho
metas.description: A behind-the-scenes look at José Mourinho's legendary career and ascent to becoming one of soccer's most celebrated and controversial coaches at the highest levels of the sport.

metas.name: 2026 · Straight to Hell
metas.description: Japan's most famous fortune-teller, Kazuko Hosoki, once held the nation in her thrall. Was she a savior or a devil? Wealth, fame, romance she had it all. But what shocking, untold half-life lay behind it?
